notice: Single source enforced by scripts/release-readiness.mjs and the release workflow for exact 1.0.0 and 1.0.0-rc.N. Decisions carry recommended values but stay red until a human sets status to approved with decidedBy/decidedAt. Derived gates re-evaluate from committed evidence on every run; operator gates require an attestation file whose statements are all literally true. Governed 0.x release ceremonies remain unaffected by the 1.0 readiness check.

stableApiClaim.note: 1.0 promises the enumerated compatibility surfaces, not a blanket stable API; stablePublicApi stays false and npm publication stays disabled.

reportRevisionR3.note: Keep 1.0 on v2/r2, publish E1 and E2 as companion corrections for their immutable schema wording, and bank r3 for the 1.1 evidence-package wire design. The versioned ServiceRole taxonomy remains public but is not added to the 1.0 report wire.

calibrationCensoringPolicy.methodologicalAssessment: The step-3 decision supersedes the global zero-censoring policy with per-detector C/B assignments derived from scripts/calibration-policy-assignments.mjs; the artifact and disposition digests below are the exact bytes a named human approved, and approval covers those bytes and their disposition only. It is not a recommendation to approve or use it, not a result, and not a critical-use claim.
calibrationCensoringPolicy.note: Approved by the named human recorded in decidedBy/decidedAt after independently reproducing the policy, disposition, and protocol-bytes digests. The superseded zero-censoring approval is preserved verbatim below and its artifact stays readable at its historical path.
